### 1. Scene
A mixed meal with roasted chicken, fresh rice-paper rolls, toast, and a few fries.

### 2. Vessel
A round dinner plate, approximately **26 cm diameter**.  
Area = 3.14 × 13² = **531 cm²**.

### 3. Items
- Roasted chicken portion, skin-on and bone-in
- One large fresh rice-paper roll containing noodles and vegetables
- One smaller rice-paper roll portion
- One slice of toast
- A few fries

No separate sauce or dressing is clearly visible.

### 4–7. Area, volume, weight, and energy
Areas below represent approximate visible coverage, avoiding double-counting overlaps. Roll heights are average heights across their rounded shapes.

| Item | Plate area | Area (cm²) | Average height (cm) | Gross volume (ml) | Bulk density (g/ml) | Estimated grams | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Chicken portion | 13% | 69 | 1.8 | 124 | 0.95 | 118 | 200* | 236 |
| Large rice-paper roll | 17% | 90 | 2.0 | 180 | 0.8 | 144 | 110 | 158 |
| Small rice-paper roll | 6% | 32 | 1.8 | 58 | 0.8 | 46 | 110 | 51 |
| Toast | 17% | 90 | 1.2 | 108 | 0.3 | 32 | 280 | 90 |
| Fries | 4% | 21 | 0.9 | 19 | 0.65 | 12 | 310 | 37 |
| **Total** | **57%** | **302** | | | | **352** | | **572** |

*Chicken weight includes its visible bone; its energy density is adjusted for the non-edible portion. Toast density uses the bread-loaf value; fries use a bulk density allowing for gaps.*

### 8. Sanity check
About **350 g and 570 kcal** is plausible for a plate slightly over half covered, with most weight coming from the rolls and chicken. The small number of fries contributes only about 12 g. A reasonable uncertainty range is **300–420 g and 470–700 kcal**, mainly depending on roll filling, chicken bone size, and added cooking fat.
